title: Canonical documentation reconciliation

conformance.reason: Task 21.2 reconciles canonical current-state documentation with the already-implemented and independently reviewed v1.2 behaviour (Phases 15-20). It introduces no new Jellyfin 12 API, lifecycle, or platform assumption, changes no Sonarr/Radarr API contract or webhook payload, and does not implement an unverified ADR clause; it records existing accepted ADRs and shipped behaviour. No pre-dispatch specialist conformance check is therefore required.
